visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A man with a black motorcycle helmet and an action camera mounted on top is riding a motorcycle on a coastal road. He wears a white tank top and a black jacket. The sun is shining brightly from a blue sky with scattered clouds. (2) The scene shifts to panoramic views of a tranquil coastal landscape. A calm body of water reflects the sun's glare, and a long, straight asphalt road extends toward a distant bridge. (3) The man is seen in a close-up, then standing in front of a red metal monument that marks the 'Westernmost Point of Taiwan.' He is now wearing a black baseball cap and poses by flexing his muscles. (4) High-angle drone footage reveals a grid of aquaculture fish ponds, a tall brown lattice-structured lighthouse, and extensive rippling sand dunes along the coastline. (5) The man speaks to the camera in a selfie shot with the lighthouse and the sea in the background under bright, natural daylight.
